name: Clustering Expansion Inventory
summary: Declarative refinement inventory for clustering runtime diagnostics and safeguards.

operations.name: Cluster Balance Analysis
operations.intent: Insert cluster-size balance analysis after point assignment.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether one cluster is much larger than another after points are assigned.

operations.name: Assignment Stability Monitoring
operations.intent: Insert assignment-change monitoring after center updates.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether too many points keep changing clusters between iterations.

operations.name: Empty Cluster Detection
operations.intent: Insert empty-cluster detection before assignment work proceeds.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether any requested cluster has no assigned points.

operations.name: Separation Validation
operations.intent: Insert cluster separation validation before center updates consume upstream state.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether clusters are separated enough to trust the current grouping.

audit.rationale: Normalizes clustering runtime expansion rules into the provider expansion asset schema.
audit.dejargonized_summary: Clustering checks for imbalance, unstable assignments, empty clusters, and weak separation now use the shared expansion schema.

migration_readiness.rationale: The operations are declared through data/expansions and backed by matcher runtime rules.

references.title: sciona.principal.expansion_rules.clustering
references.note: Runtime rule names and diagnostics in sciona-matcher.
